verdict.rationale: Unreal documents first-party automation: Python editor scripting to automate repetitive asset and level tasks, the Unreal Automation Tool for build and test processes, headless commandlet runs such as -run=cook, and the Gauntlet and Automation Test frameworks. These let scripted jobs run unattended. However, nothing in the evidence shows a built-in way to schedule or trigger those jobs autonomously in the background; that would need an external scheduler or CI. missing for 10: built-in scheduling/triggers for background automation runs, any agentic or AI-driven automation layer, an official MCP or agent integration, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended automation.
